payload.title: Postgres runtime store backend (first-class)
payload.description: Land Postgres as a first-class runtime backend in Rust (sqlx or tokio-postgres): every store port implemented, migrations runner (port/replace the standalone TS migration runner), multi-node correctness for durable jobs/projections using Postgres locking (advisory locks / SKIP LOCKED), and CI coverage against a real Postgres service. Completes the FR-4 direction as part of the rewrite.
